estimate: Approximately 90–120 minutes implementation/test iteration, 35–60 minutes matrix and focused verification depending on existing build artifacts, then 25–45 minutes independent unit/final checking. Four-hour run budget is plausible but predicate migration/fanout omissions are the main risk. Stop and preserve incomplete work if required evidence cannot be obtained; do not narrow acceptance.

findings.evidence: Baseline FeatureFilter methods return bool through many detailed helper predicates. ThreadedReplayer reduces them to Unsupported counts; #18 only emits Parse/Create reasons. No new runtime evidence was collected during planning.

PipelineWorkItem dependency_blocked and enqueue_pipeline detect null handles without retained parent identity. StateReplayer missing shader/layout/parent reads can return false as generic parse; static/lazy PipelineResolver failures currently attach creation error to the consumer. These are the critical semantic repair points.

Large feature predicate surface and three pipeline/reference paths make omission risk material. Require an explicit predicate/applicability inventory and actual full production-path fanout fixtures. Retained worker evidence must stay bounded; exact attempt-local counts do not establish global item accounting.

assertions: Register replay-support-compute with explicit Release-active checks. Synthetic non-null feature initialization; a supported control returns true and clears a reused result.

Exercise actual descriptorBuffer/subgroup feature rejection, a real extension-bearing pNext rejection, maxComputeWorkGroupSize or maxComputeWorkGroupInvocations rejection using registered module entry-point information, and unknown pNext sType. Assert exact support kind, stable feature/extension/property identifier, known observed/required values and raw unknown sType. Reject before driver creation.
Keep previous bool compute_pipeline_is_supported caller results identical; distinguish missing/invalid module metadata from a known feature limit rather than inventing device support facts.

Register replay-support-graphics. Supported graphics control and independently selected real feature (for example depthClamp), extension, existing property-limit (for example multiview/mesh output/subgroup limits), and unknown nested pNext rejection.

Assert exact originating identifier and observed/required fields where the detector has values; nested predicate failure must preserve the specific reason rather than overwrite it with a generic graphics rejection. Unrelated disabled features must not steal attribution.

Register replay-support-raytracing. Supported control; rayTracingPipeline feature, VK_KHR_pipeline_library extension, maxRayRecursionDepth and maxRayHitAttributeSize boundaries, and unknown stage/group/library pNext cases.
Assert correct identifier, required input versus available property values, known bits, and identical old bool support decisions. Boundary equality succeeds and one-over-limit rejects.

Register replay-support-static. Cover sampler, descriptor-set layout, pipeline layout, shader module, render pass and render pass2 entrypoints with supported controls and applicable feature/extension/unknown-sType rejections.

Static-family property tests exercise actual maxPushConstantsSize/maxBoundDescriptorSets and available render-pass limits; sampler has no independent property-limit predicate and must not gain fabricated policy just to fill a test matrix. Document precise applicability in the fixture table.

Check exact SPIR-V capability/extension identifiers and unknown capability values for shader support rejection; malformed SPIR-V and creation OOM remain distinguishable from unsupported. Feature/extension/property/unknown-sType coverage spans every migrated family and each static entrypoint has actual supported/rejected coverage.

Register replay-support-categories using actual parser/filter/Vulkan producer paths: invalid JSON/module parse, SPIR-V validation rejection, VK_ERROR_OUT_OF_HOST_MEMORY, VK_ERROR_OUT_OF_DEVICE_MEMORY, known support rejection and missing dependency.

Assert returned outcome/category, exact signed Vulkan result where available, zero unsupported counts for parse/OOM/dependency failures, zero creation counts for unsupported/blocked work, and a valid succeeding control after every failure. Do not promise allocator-exhaustion containment beyond controlled existing producers.

Register replay-dependency-module-fanout. A dependency-complete recorded/checked FOZ graph has one invalid or controlled-failed shader module referenced by N distinct pipelines, with N at least 4, across compute/graphics/raytracing consumers as applicable.

Drive actual production parse/resolve/enqueue/creation paths rather than manually setting dependency_blocked. Assert exactly one originating module failure per worker attempt, N distinct blocked consumer identities, every edge names the actual parent tag/hash and its known failure category, and zero Vulkan pipeline creation calls for blocked consumers.

Cover invalid module and a controlled shader-creation failure separately; positive graph creates every expected pipeline. Repeat with one and multiple workers within the ThreadedReplayer process and more than one pipeline memory context. No global cross-process logical-item reconciliation claim is introduced.

Register replay-dependency-parent-fanout. One real failed derivative base or pipeline library has N consumers; exercise compute/graphics derivative paths and graphics/raytracing library paths supported by production infrastructure.

Assert one originating parent creation failure, N linked blocked consumers and zero creation calls for those consumers. Include missing and nested library identities; original hash/tag must survive native handle resolution and sorted dependency scheduling.

A valid parent/consumer control succeeds. Multiple missing parents may retain one bounded first blocker with explicit omitted detail; never fabricate an arbitrary parent or count unattempted consumers as compiler faults.

Register replay-dependency-common-cache. Generate/check actual outer FOZ inputs with a consumer reference omitted from the common-cache/input dependency set: shader, layout/static dependency and base/library parent variants where represented.

Assert missing dependency reason plus exact consumer and missing parent tag/hash, no driver-failure raw result or compiler-fault attribution, zero consumer creation calls, unsuccessful aggregate outcome, and successful equivalent graph with common-cache entries restored.

Input read failure, absent resource and malformed present parent remain distinguishable facts; absence is not called device unsupported. Preserve the original parent failure when recursive parse is involved.

Register replay-dependency-static. Drive sampler/descriptor-layout/pipeline-layout/render-pass dependency substitution paths with real recorded hashes. A failed or missing static parent names the correct edge rather than becoming a new generic consumer Parse/Create failure.

Retain source identities before remapping handles, including static resolve through maintenance4 PipelineResolver. Known originating vkCreate failure stays attached to the static parent; blocked pipeline has no creation call. Successful lazy and ordinary static resolution controls retain expected handles and cleanup.

Register replay-support-call-scope. Per-call detail receivers have value lifetime independent of create-info/pNext storage. Reuse clears stale values; nested calls preserve the first specific origin and independent reentrant calls keep separate receivers.

Barrier-controlled concurrent checks on the same initialized FeatureFilter produce their own exact reasons with no cross-thread leakage. If a callback sink is chosen, explicitly test its documented threading, lifetime/reentrancy and bounded error behavior; a value-output-only design avoids a new callback boundary.
Dependency capture context cannot outlive the parser callback or allocator/memory context; retain only scalar/value identities in queued work and worker frames.

Register replay-support-worker-details and replay-dependency-worker-details using actual detector-to-production-worker/controller pipe paths, extending existing #18 fixtures rather than hand-constructed controller summaries.

With prose disabled, assert support identifier/kind/known values and dependency consumer/parent tag/hash/category, exact worker/attempt, unsuccessful native/final outcome, and positive completion control. Human diagnostics present the same observed facts; no guessed upgrade/extension advice.

Explicitly document/version private detail transport. Preserve existing parse/create/timeout event semantics, HELLO/FINAL uncertainty, legacy lines and absent negotiation; unknown or malformed new details cannot certify supported/successful work.

implementation: Add structured support detail with stable kind/reason identifiers, feature/extension/property names, raw unknown sType/capability and explicit known required/available values. Preserve existing bool methods through additive overloads or explicit per-call context; no shared mutable last-error. Migrate detailed existing rejection sites, including common pNext/SPIR-V/subgroup helpers, while preserving first specific reason. Generic fallback is honest only when the detector truly lacks detail, not a substitute for known predicates.

Pilot compute internally, then carry the same contract through graphics/raytracing and static objects before this one unit completes. Unit fixture applicability table names existing checks for every entrypoint; do not add invented limits or omit existing supported controls. Keep malformed input and native OOM outside Unsupported.

Capture typed source dependency identities before StateReplayer and ThreadedReplayer replace hash handles with native handles. Use a scoped private capture/reference adapter or explicit internal context without changing public StateCreatorInterface virtual signatures. Recursive parse preserves originating parent reason; queued work owns scalar consumer/parent identities. Missing static/common-cache references become blocked dependency facts rather than fresh consumer compiler/parse faults.

Unify blocked consumer recording across shader resolution, static/lazy maintenance4 resolver, derivative base and pipeline-library ordering. Record one originating failure for one cached failed dependency within a worker attempt and one blocked observation per affected logical consumer. Preserve parent failure category when known; mark missing/unknown distinctly. Never call the consumer Vulkan create branch when blocked.

Extend bounded private worker support/dependency detail and controller retention using the existing #18 architecture, documenting exact version/unknown-field rules and count scope. Human messages derive from the same facts. Keep aggregate category counts independent from bounded examples/omission and retain legacy protocol, native termination and FINAL semantics. Update local-docs/specs/replay-worker-events.md and verification.md for delivered boundaries.

Add registered Release-active M19 runners/fixtures, exact test mapping and sensitivity controls; update CHANGELOG.md in the same candidate with one factual Observability sentence and full issue #19 link. No production task/state mutations by implementer/checker.

Legacy identity: `FOS-000010`. Original source: [immutable historical definition](https://github.com/robinwassen/Fossilize/blob/73f891d6c0cf498ac92e804d7d0f0cd344a083f5/local-docs/reviews/observability-sweep.md).

Shared requirements and grouping: https://github.com/robinwassen/Fossilize/issues/8. All original criteria below remain required. Source status statements below describe their historical revision; current delivery evidence is recorded separately. Original relative links are resolved below.

## Original definition (verbatim)

10. **FOS-000010 — Explain unsupported features and blocked dependencies.** **M, staged by resource type; depends on `FOS-000009`; §1–§2.** Feature filter predicates return bool, often at detailed feature/property checks; [setup:1270](https://github.com/robinwassen/Fossilize/blob/556da9ff7d7616704dda515756219ab1dab693ec/cli/fossilize_replay.cpp#L1270) reduces this to “not supported.” Return feature/extension/property identifiers and relevant limits when known. Pilot compute, then graphics/ray-tracing/static objects. Link missing/failed parents or modules to blocked consumers rather than counting consumers as independent compiler faults. **Check:** one unsupported feature; one invalid module referenced by many pipelines; missing common-cache input; unknown pNext sType. Preserve existing support advice only where justified. Do not make “unsupported” a catch-all for parse, OOM or missing dependency failures.

   **Required automated success criteria — pending implementation:**

   - **Feature-filter unit tests per migrated resource type:** Known feature, extension, property-limit and unknown-sType rejections return the correct identifier and available observed/required values; supported controls succeed. Parse errors and OOM remain separate categories.
   - **Dependency-graph tests:** One failed shader/module or parent referenced by N pipelines yields one originating failure and N correctly linked blocked consumers, with zero creation calls for those unattempted consumers. Missing-common-cache cases identify a missing dependency without claiming the driver failed.
